extracted.intended_audience: members of news organizations / journalists who cover the NFL
extracted.subtask_description: Page lists NFL news releases and provides instructions about registering for password‑protected NFL Communications access; registration is limited to accredited news organizations who regularly cover the NFL on site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered access eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered access to the password-protected section of the website is granted solely to members of news organizations who cover the NFL on-site on a regular basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Call to action: "Register Now" — registration is required to obtain access to the password‑protected communications area; eligibility limited to news organizations' members who regularly cover the NFL on site.
